# SpikingNeuralNetworkBenchmark

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A standardized, open framework for evaluating and comparing local learning rules on spiking neural networks across multiple tasks and metrics. Provides reproducible baselines and accelerates progress in neuromorphic computing by enabling fair comparison of learning algorithms.
